reason: It's one apartment next to our house, so if a guest has a question they can mostly knock or my mother answers. In August I am tired, yes, but €120 is real money for me and I don't want a robot talking to my guests in my name.
objection: What if it tells a German family the wrong beach or the wrong check-out time and they write it in the review? One bad review hurts me more than all the time it saves, and I am the one who pays for it, not the company.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it running for a whole summer at a neighbour's apartment here in Omiš with no complaints, and being able to try it free in June before paying anything.
